exposure: history of parasitic and/or mycotic infections in childhood
history of viral infections in childhood
outcome: occupational asthma (OA) to vegetable textile dusts
cohort: 57 cases with occupational asthma to vegetable textile dusts and 112 age- and gender-matched controls working in the textile sector without any allergic diseases
finding: Four factors related to the Hygiene Hypothesis (lowest sibling rank, contact with animals, history of parasitic/mycotic infections in childhood, and history of viral infections in childhood) were independently associated with occupational asthma to vegetable textile dusts.
